final_wiki.answer-Q-6053-A59:
The number of days from 2020-12-13 to 2021-12-12 (counting the end date but not the start date) is 362 days.

Calculation: 
- 2020-12-13 to 2020-12-31 = 18 days
- 2021 is a non-leap year, so it has 365 days.
- Total = 18 + 365 = 362 days.
